claims.quote: Melanotaenia nigrans comes from northern Australia, where it is irregularly distributed: from the Kimberley region in Western Australia through the northern part of the Northern Territory to the Cape York Peninsula in northern Queensland, including a number of offshore islands such as Groote Eylandt in the Gulf of Carpentaria and some islands in the Torres Strait.
There are persistent rumors that the species also occurs in New Guinea, but it has never been scientifically proven there.
The species is said to be naturalized in the Philippines.
